answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the yarrow of a task receipt, and the lagoon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the hollow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
